verdict.rationale: HubSpot documents a broad public REST API covering contacts (e.g. `POST /crm/v3/objects/contacts`), custom objects with batch retrieval, the webhooks journal, and account info. It backs this with date-based versioning, a maintained deprecation/sunset policy, per-endpoint inline OpenAPI 3.0.1 specs, agent-readable markdown docs with a /docs/llms.txt index, and free test accounts. The probe 404s hit root paths (/llms.txt, /openapi.json), not the documented /docs/llms.txt or per-page specs, so they do not contradict the docs. Missing for 10: documentation of API authentication, rate limits and scopes in the evidence, and independent or hands-on corroboration of driving the product via the API.
